workspace.todos.description: Search the configured workspace for common TODO-style marker tokens using bounded UTF-8 file reads. This returns mechanical line matches and does not summarize, infer priority, or execute commands.

case_sensitive.description: Whether marker matching is case-sensitive. Defaults to false.

include_hidden.description: Whether to include hidden files and directories. Defaults to false.

markers.description: Optional literal marker tokens to search for. Defaults to TODO, FIXME, HACK, and XXX.

max_bytes_per_file.description: Optional per-file read cap in bytes. Defaults to 1048576.

max_files.description: Optional scanned file cap. Defaults to 500.

path.description: Optional workspace-relative file or directory path. Defaults to workspace root.

workspace_id.description: Stable workspace id returned by workspace.list.

workspace.todos.name: workspace.todos
workspace.todos.title: Workspace Todos

xml.read.description: Read and parse a workspace-contained XML file into a bounded element tree using Foundation XMLParser. This is read-only, disables external entity resolution, and does not validate schemas or infer business semantics.

max_bytes.description: Maximum XML bytes to parse. Defaults to policy.max_output_bytes.

max_depth.description: Maximum XML nesting depth to return. Defaults to 64.

max_nodes.description: Maximum XML elements to return. Defaults to 10000.

max_text_bytes.description: Maximum direct text bytes to retain per element. Defaults to 8192.

path.description: Workspace-relative or in-workspace absolute XML file path.

trim_text.description: Whether to trim whitespace-only text in returned element text. Defaults to true.

workspace_id.description: Stable workspace id returned by workspace.list.

xml.read.name: xml.read
xml.read.title: Xml Read

yaml.read.description: Read and parse a workspace-contained YAML file into JSON-compatible values using Yams. This is read-only, supports multiple YAML documents, and does not execute subprocesses or infer business semantics.

max_bytes.description: Maximum YAML bytes to parse. Defaults to policy.max_output_bytes.

max_depth.description: Maximum nested YAML depth to convert. Defaults to 128.

max_documents.description: Maximum YAML documents to return. Defaults to 50.

path.description: Workspace-relative or in-workspace absolute YAML file path.

workspace_id.description: Stable workspace id returned by workspace.list.

yaml.read.name: yaml.read
yaml.read.title: Yaml Read
